messages:
ria-ops: Heads up — new KMS deny rule landed in the eu-keystore account and it's blocking node bootstrap in eu-west-1. Warm pool size dropping fast, GPU prewarm failing :warning:

miguel: ugh, which rule id? can we scope a temporary exception? :eyes:

ria-ops: rule id = deny:kms:restrict-decrypt-2026-03. It was scoped to all servicePrincipals in eu-keystore. Node agent decrypts instance identity via keystore-proxy and that proxy is getting 403s. logs:```2026-03-04T10:02:12Z keystore-proxy ERROR decrypt failed code=AccessDenied principal=sp:node-bootstrap service=keystore````

leah-sec: That rule was intended to block a misconfigured cross-account principal. We rolled it quickly but may have been too broad. I can narrow it but want to confirm which principals to allow.

jesse-sre: Impact: ~120 warm GPUs in eu-west-1 not prewarming -> autoscaler spinning up more hot nodes, cost spike showing on billing alerts. We have spike from 02:00 UTC.

samir: Metric snapshot: warm_pool_target=500, warm_pool_current=380, failed_bootstrap=0.24% -> appears small per node but aggregated causes 40% more on-demand starts.

emily-eng: Any workaround we can flip while we refine the rule? Maybe route keystore requests to fallback region or allow keystore-proxy role specifically.

leah-sec: I can add an allow for role:arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/keystore-proxy-eu and service principal ec2.amazonaws.com for our node agents. Will that be enough?

ria-ops: That role is in the allowlist already for other regions, yes. If you add explicit allow before the deny it should unblock bootstraps. We need a fast rollback plan if anything else is impacted.

platform-bot: deploy 1719990021 by leah-sec: policy-update/keystore-restrict applied to eu-keystore. Status: applied -> triggered alert keystore:access:deny:eu.

leah-sec: Applying a scoped allow now and will monitor. Pasting candidate diff:```{
  "Sid": "AllowKeystoreProxyBootstrap",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/keystore-proxy-eu"},
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:RequestedRegion": "eu-west-1"}}
}```

miguel: Nice. After that we should run a rolling restart of keystore-proxy in eu-west-1 to pick up policy cache change. Right now many proxies are hitting cached deny.

jesse-sre: Rolling restart approved. I'll coordinate with infra CI to drain, restart, and verify warm pool recovery. ETA 10m.

samir: One postmortem note: audit logs show the policy was previewed in staging but the staging keystore had a service principal difference (account IDs). We should add a pre-flight check that validates principal ARNs against a known mapping.

leah-sec: Agreed — adding mapping + automated test in the policy CI. For now, allow is in and I'm watching.

platform-bot: healthcheck eu-west-1 warmpool delta: before=500 after=392 current=498 (10:40 UTC).

emily-eng: warmpool back up. Cost spike stopped and rolling restart didn't drop traffic. Thanks all. :tada:

ria-ops: Filing follow-up ticket to tighten audit retention and add KMS policy preflight: INFRA-4721. Also tag owners for runbook update (keystore-proxy failover).

leah-sec: Will do a postmortem blameless writeup with timeline and the policy diff. Expect a short writeup by EOD.

jesse-sre: Closing incident channel once writeup posted. Great triage team. :thumbsup:
